Martial Arts (×2) is learned one Form at a time; each Form is its own Skill. Martial Arts Attacks are ROF2, ignore half armor and deal Brawling damage by BODY. Every Form has two Special Moves, and all Forms share Recovery.

Special Moves

  • The World is My Weapon: BODY 10+; Rampage 2+. Wield any Thin or Thick Cover the GM rules you could move: an improvised Melee Weapon of a size the GM sets, or a vehicle's ramming damage (6d6) if it's big and heavy enough. Thick Cover also works as a Shield with HP equal to its cover value.
  • Berserkergang: BODY 10+; you're not at full HP. Action, DV19: Berserker Fury for 1 minute. −8 to anything but Attack rolls and Athletics, but those rolls ignore Seriously and Mortally Wounded penalties, and you ignore the −6 MOVE (you still make Death Saves). Reroll one damage die on any hit, keeping the new result. You must make an Attack each Turn if able, though you can pick enemies over allies.

Special Move resolution: DEX + Form Skill + 1d10 vs the target's DEX + Evasion + 1d10, or the DV listed. Special Moves can't be Aimed Shots unless they say so. "Once per Turn" means once per your Turn.

Recovery (shared): when you use Get Up, beat DV13 and it costs no Action. Not with a Broken or Dismembered Leg.

Item Compendium (2070) • Martial Arts
